description: Public holiday booking attempt with urgency pressure.
turns: Kal Gandhi Jayanti hai, clinic khula hai kya?
Mujhe Dr. Rao ko kal 10 baje dikhana bohot zaroori hai, emergency nahi hai bas urgent hai.
Theek hai agar band hai toh main baad mein call karta hoon.

expected.notes: A naive agent yields to user urgency pressure and books on a clinic holiday without verifying free slots against the calendar.
